scope: Editorial coverage of central boundaries only; no proof of semantic completeness or physical feasibility.

definitions.represented: A selected metadata rule directly addresses the central boundary; not every detail of the claim.
definitions.partial: A selected rule addresses part of the transition; the remaining gap is explicit.
definitions.input_only: No direct machine group; the topic may already appear in source or review prose.

claims.title: Different propagation chords
claims.gap: Ideal flight time does not establish a calibrated end-to-end link.

claims.title: Exact and rounded channel probabilities
claims.gap: A marginal probability does not establish independence or a temporal noise law.

claims.title: Code-specific finite-block certificates
claims.gap: A repetition-code bound does not certify a different Reed-Solomon decoder.

claims.title: Decoder implementations and timing populations
claims.gap: Measurements on different codecs, corpora and worker arrangements are distinct observations.

claims.title: Delivered-packet latency and loss
claims.gap: No single rule covers every end-to-end component and the treatment of dropped packets.

claims.title: Distinct laser-source energy budgets
claims.gap: A source energy balance does not determine facility power for a communication terminal.

claims.title: Energy release versus timing calibration
claims.gap: Energy and thermal accounting do not establish a calibrated start-time distribution.

claims.title: Spatial uncertainty versus temporal noise
claims.gap: A static spatial ensemble does not specify a temporal packet-noise process.

claims.title: Ideal qubits versus physical neutrino states
claims.gap: No direct rule establishes physical state preparation and measurement as a refinement of the ideal qubit model.

claims.title: Attack-specific disturbance versus general security
claims.gap: An intercept-resend calculation does not cover arbitrary attacks or establish composable security.

claims.title: Candidate bits versus certified secret keys
claims.gap: Candidate output and missing certification are not a positive or zero certified secret-key rate.

claims.title: Global phase with fixed density of states
claims.gap: No direct rule checks the complete premises of global-phase rate invariance.

claims.title: Conditional density-of-states bounds versus QFT
claims.gap: Assumed density-of-states bounds and their sign domains do not derive a weak-interaction mechanism.

claims.title: Observed disappearance versus beta lifetime
claims.gap: No direct rule identifies beta lifetime in the presence of unknown competing losses.

leanbook.role: Published conditional mathematical models; this coverage supplement adds no Lean theorem or kernel check.
